audit.whatIsWrong: The rockets were called 'CH-3X Rockets' in two places. That is not the ability's name. The packet also logged the defect 'never names any of Heimerdinger's abilities'.
audit.why: Riot data: W is Hextech Micro-Rockets (1325 range, 11/10/9/8/7s), E is CH-2 Electron Storm Grenade (flat 11s), Q is H-28 G Evolution Turret (1s, 20 mana), R is UPGRADE!!!. 'CH-3X' is a fragment of an old grenade name attached to the wrong slot, so a player searching for it finds nothing.
audit.corrected: Hextech Micro-Rockets (W) and CH-2 Electron Storm Grenade (E) named with their real cooldowns and the 1325 rocket range.

audit.whatIsWrong: The full layer gave Heimerdinger all seven stages, including 2+ items at 2/10 — while the content layer on the same matchup gives Garen Level 3, Level 6, first item and 2+ items.
audit.why: The packet chart is Heimer/Heimer/Garen/Heimer/Garen/Garen/Garen and the win rate is 53.83% over 927 games. The content layer already matches the packet exactly; only the full layer's phases were wrong, and they were wrong in the direction that tells a winning Garen he loses every stage.
audit.corrected: phases[2], [4], [5], [6] flipped to Garen with ratings raised; phases[0], [1], [3] left with Heimerdinger, matching packet and content.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.spikes named no stages at all, and report[2] said only 'your item spikes' / 'his item spikes'.
audit.why: The real shape is two Garen windows — Level 3 when Q-E can clear a turret and close, and Level 6 onward — split by a Heimerdinger window at Levels 4-5 when the grenade and a full turret line reassert.
audit.corrected: Both summary lines now name the actual stages.

audit.whatIsWrong: The grenade's cooldown was written once as 11s with no note that it does not scale.
audit.why: CH-2 Electron Storm Grenade is a flat 11s at every rank — unusual, and it means the punish window never shrinks as he levels. A direct hit stuns; the surrounding splash only slows, so the dodge is worth a lot.
audit.corrected: Flat-11s-at-every-rank and the direct-hit-vs-splash distinction written into report[5] and dosFull[0].
